newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH POLIFARB DEBICA SETS ISSUE PRICE AT PLN 65.
newsitem.headline: POLISH POLIFARB DEBICA SETS ISSUE PRICE AT PLN 65.

text.p: Polish paintmaker Polifarb Debica SA set issue price of its 700,000-initial public offering at 65 zlotys per share, the company said in a statement on Friday.
The price was set at the maximum of the earlier set range of between 55 and 65 zlotys.
The company, which starts its offering on Monday, has said it hopes to start bourse trade in April.

Large investors will subscribe for 350,000 shares from February 17 to 18, while retail investors and current shareholders will subscribe for 150,000 and 200,000 shares respectively from February 17 to February 21.
Polifarb Debica expects its 1997 net profit to rise to 17 million zlotys on 148.1-million-zloty sales, up from 1996's net-profit estimate of 12.8 million zlotys on sales of 137.5 million zlotys.
